manager.title: OpenXR Layer Manager
manager.intro: Toggle implicit API layers and adjust order within one registry hive at a time. Changes apply to future XR app launches.
manager.notLoaded: OpenXR layer state has not loaded yet.

warnings.quadOrder: {slice}: Quad-Views-Foveated should be above VectorXR for Pivot compatibility.
warnings.toolkitTurbo: OpenXR Toolkit is enabled while VectorXR Turbo is in use. Two frame-pacing layers fight each other — if OXRTK's Turbo Mode is on, disable it there or in VectorXR, never both.
warnings.toolkitQuad: OpenXR Toolkit is above VectorXR ({slices}). It does not support quad views, so VectorXR keeps Quadviews off for every game OpenXR Toolkit runs in. Disable OpenXR Toolkit, or turn it off for those games, to use Quadviews.

status.unlocked: Machine-wide OpenXR layer writes are unlocked for this app session.
status.unlockBeforeToggle: Unlock admin writes before changing machine-wide OpenXR layers.
status.unlockBeforeReorder: Unlock admin writes before reordering machine-wide OpenXR layers.
status.unlockBeforeRemove: Unlock admin writes before removing machine-wide OpenXR layer registrations.
status.removeFailed: Failed to remove OpenXR layer registration

slice.descriptionRecommended: Recommended for most Windows PCVR layers. Order below applies only inside this registry slice.
slice.description32: Uncommon: usually only relevant for legacy 32-bit OpenXR applications.
slice.descriptionPerUser: Uncommon: valid for per-user registrations, but separate from machine-wide ordering.
slice.readOnlyNotice: Machine-wide layer controls are read-only until administrator approval is granted.
slice.unlockHelp: Request administrator approval to enable machine-wide OpenXR layer controls for this app session.
slice.empty: No implicit OpenXR layers are registered in this slice.

layer.moveUpAction: Move this layer earlier in this hive.
layer.moveDownAction: Move this layer later in this hive.
layer.removeAction: Remove this registration from the selected registry hive. Files will remain on disk.
layer.perUserWrite: {action} This per-user hive should not require administrator approval.
layer.lockedWrite: {action} Unlock admin writes before changing machine-wide OpenXR layers.
layer.unlockedWrite: {action} Machine-wide writes are unlocked for this app session.
layer.vectorXrTooltip: VectorXR API layer. You are here!
layer.vectorXrDisabledTooltip: VectorXR's OpenXR layer is disabled. OpenXR Enhancements will not apply even if the suite or individual Enhancements are enabled.
layer.quadViewsTooltip: Quad-Views-Foveated layer. For Pivot compatibility, this should occur above the VectorXR layer in the same registry slice.
layer.manifestMissing: The registered manifest path does not exist.
layer.libraryMissing: The layer DLL could not be resolved or does not exist.
layer.needsReview: This layer has a condition that may need review.

signature.unsignedTooltip: Signature unverified. This may cause problems with games that use anti-cheat software.
signature.invalidTooltipWithDate: Signature invalid. Certificate was valid through {date}.
signature.invalidTooltip: Signature invalid. Open details for Windows signature information.
signature.unknownTooltip: Signature status unknown. Open details for Windows signature information.
signature.unsignedGuidance: Unsigned OpenXR layers can be legitimate, but may conflict with games or platforms that enforce anti-cheat policies while the layer is enabled.
signature.invalidGuidanceWithDate: Windows did not verify this signature. The signing certificate was valid through {date}.
signature.invalidGuidance: Windows did not verify this signature.
signature.unknownGuidance: Windows could not determine a signature status for this binary.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: This permanently removes the layer registration from {slice}. The manifest and DLL files will remain on disk, but this action cannot be undone from VectorXR.
remove.descriptionSelectedHive: This permanently removes the layer registration from the selected registry hive. The manifest and DLL files will remain on disk, but this action cannot be undone from VectorXR.
